verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs have a dedicated page stating that Runpod provides two official MCP servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod, and a probe independently confirmed that page exists. One server manages Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes and registries through the REST API, authenticating with Sign in with Runpod or an API key. Missing for 10: details of the second MCP server and per-client setup steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
